manifest.caption: Per-layer microbenchmark latency for sparse rank-16 Signed Top-2 and dense rank-4 softmax at the same reported analytical active FLOPs of 619,773,952 per layer. Sparse routing measures 0.753 ms versus 0.533 ms for dense composition; stored parameter counts are not matched.
